## Deployment and Operations Manual

Software version 0.7.0  \
Manual version 1.0  \
Controlled release: 2026-09-23

This manual covers the supported review workstation and hospital Model API deployment. It is written for hospital IT operators and maintainers. It does not replace the [Clinician User Manual](../CLINICIAN_USER_MANUAL.pdf).

::: {.callout-warning title="WARNING - protected deployment"}
Keep the Model API on a protected hospital network. Do not expose it directly to the public internet. Apply hospital firewall, TLS, authentication, and secret-management policy at the deployment boundary.
:::
